title: What the Cross Teaches Us About People
headline: How Jesus Saw the People Who Hurt Him
tagline: The cross proves God never reduced people to the worst thing they had ever done.
seo_title: How Jesus Saw People Who Hurt Him: Luke 23:34 for Men | TheWrkShop
seo_description: Sin explained what they were doing; it did not determine what they were worth. A devotional for men on Luke 23:34, forgiveness and seeing image-bearers.
verse_text: Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing.

scriptures.text: Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing.

blocks.text: Jesus could forgive His enemies because He never stopped seeing them as people His Father loved.

items: Jesus never reduced people to what they were doing.
to the image of God that sin had distorted but never destroyed.
It can harden a person’s heart.
But it can never erase the value God placed upon them when He created them in His image.
He did not come merely to forgive sinful actions.
Think about Jesus on the cross.
Surrounded by mockers, critics, betrayers, religious leaders, soldiers and criminals.
Yet Jesus saw people worth loving.
But He also never allowed sin to define the deepest truth about a person.
Sin explained what they were doing.
It did not determine what they were worth.

blocks.text: The next time someone frustrates you, ask yourself:
Am I responding to what this person is doing…. or remembering who this person still is?

items: Deeply in need of the same grace that rescued me.
The cross proves God never reduced people to the worst thing they had ever done.
He saw what sin had done to them….
without forgetting who He created them to be.
May we learn to see people the same way.
